To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the customer satisfaction of the banking industry in Pakistan is not satisfactory.
the customer satisfaction is positively related to service quality.
the customer of the banking sector of Pakistan is satisfied with the service quality of the bank.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of customer satisfaction with service quality in conventional banks in Pakistan, with a special reference to Faisalabad city.
customer perception about the service quality in conventional banks.
the service quality and customer satisfaction in the context of banking industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the banks should focus on those areas of service quality which are perceived as the lowest level of service quality by customers.
the customer satisfaction is directly related to the service quality and it is a key factor for the success of banking industry in any country.
the banks should focus on the areas which are not satisfying the customer and should try to enhance the service quality of the bank in order to achieve a higher customer satisfaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the customer is the king in today’s business world, and the banks should take care of customer’s satisfaction with respect to the service quality.
customer satisfaction is a key factor in the success of the service industry and it is the most important element for the success of any business.
customer satisfaction with respect of service quality is a complex and multi-dimensional concept and that it is a function of many variables.
The main takeaway from our work is that
customer satisfaction with service quality in conventional bank in Faisalabad is moderate.
the customer satisfaction with the service quality of banks in Pakistan can be improved by improving the tangibles, reliability, and assurance dimensions of service quality.
the bank managers should focus on the areas of tangibles, assurance, and empathy in order to enhance their service quality.
